summary: Design and govern generative AI for service, self-service, and sales channels. Build practical controls, metrics, and pilot plans. Enquire today.
lede: Generative AI orchestration helps customer-service and sales professionals design customer-facing interactions with clear human oversight. For CX leaders, contact-centre managers and digital-product teams, the course covers prioritizing journeys by value and risk, grounding replies in approved knowledge, mapping escalation, testing model behaviour, and monitoring customer-trust and resolution indicators for a governed pilot.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for customer journeys, service operations, sales enablement, digital products, and AI control decisions. It suits beginner-to-intermediate practitioners who can bring a real or representative customer-channel use case and need a structured route from opportunity assessment to governed pilot design.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of customer experience, contact-centre operations, digital self-service, sales support, or marketing operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a representative customer-channel use case, basic journey information, and any publicly shareable service or product content for the exercises. Advanced topics such as model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, OWASP LLM risks, and ISO/IEC 42001 controls receive operational application treatment, not production engineering depth.
